title: Road traffic counts (hourly), Mobility Office
summary: Hourly vehicle counts per road counter (counter_id, ts_local, vehicles), described in the catalog as counted near the monitoring stations. Catalog metadata states about 15 million rows, coverage from 2021-01-01 with no end date, and hourly refresh (last refreshed 2026-10-12). A wiki page records that the road counters were replaced on 2024-03-18 and counting changed from per-direction to both-directions combined, which the catalog does not mention. Counter-to-station mapping and direction fields are not documented in the catalog.

fields.name: ts_local
fields.description: Hour start, local time (time zone not stated)

schema.notes: No direction field in the catalog schema, although the wiki says counts were per direction before 2024-03-18 and both directions combined after. No counter location or station-link field.

temporal.refresh_cadence: hourly (catalog refresh_cadence field; no stated lag)

spatial.code_system: counter_id codes (no documented mapping to coordinates, roads or monitoring stations)
spatial.notes: Country is from the use-case geography; the catalog does not state a location beyond an Azure storage path. Distance from each counter to each monitoring station is not documented.

licence.name: internal
licence.evidence: get_catalog_entry internal.traffic.hourly_counts: classification 'internal'; no licence field present in the catalog entry

access.request_process: Request to the Mobility Office (catalog access.request_process). Data access was not tested; only catalog and wiki metadata were read.

documentation_excerpts: Catalog description: 'Vehicles counted per hour by road counters near the monitoring stations.'
Wiki counter_replacement_2024 (last_edited 2024-04-02): 'On 2024-03-18 the road counters were replaced.'
Wiki counter_replacement_2024: 'Before that date, counts were recorded per direction. From 2024-03-18, counts are both directions combined.'
Wiki counter_replacement_2024: 'Do not compare counts across the change without adjusting for it. The catalog entry for traffic.hourly_counts has no note about this.'
quality_notes: Series break: wiki counter_replacement_2024 (last_edited 2024-04-02) says counters were replaced on 2024-03-18 and counting changed from per-direction to both-directions combined. The catalog entry (exported 2026-10-14) has no note, and its temporal_coverage starts 2021-01-01, so the pre-break and post-break regimes sit in one table with no flag. The production window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31) straddles the break, so about 2.5 months of 2024 are on the old basis.

Catalog schema has no direction field, so the counting basis cannot be identified per row from the table alone. Counter-level or timestamp-level filtering on the change date would need confirmation from the Mobility Office.

Catalog vs wiki on currency: catalog says last_refreshed 2026-10-12 and refresh hourly; the wiki was last edited 2024-04-02. The wiki may be out of date for any later counter changes, which is unknown.
Time zone: ts_local is described as local time with no zone or DST handling stated. Alignment with UTC-based air-quality data needs a documented conversion.
Counter-to-station mapping is not documented; the catalog only says counters are 'near the monitoring stations'. Distances are unknown.
Gaps, outages, counting method and validation are not documented.
Restrictions or lockdown-type regime changes in 2024-2025 are not flagged in the catalog or wiki pages read; this was not checked further.
Row count is approximate (about 15,000,000); size in bytes is not stated.

provenance.claim: Catalog fields: owner Mobility Office, steward Luca Ferri, status active, classification internal, grain hourly, coverage start 2021-01-01 with end null, refresh hourly, last_refreshed 2026-10-12, row_count_approx 15000000, access warehouse_sql with request to Mobility Office.
Columns are counter_id (string), ts_local (timestamp, hour start local time), vehicles (integer); none is marked PII.
Counters were replaced on 2024-03-18; counts changed from per-direction to both directions combined; the catalog has no note on this.
The wiki is listed as the only backlink to the catalog entry.
